writer.name: 安妮・蓓蕾丝特 Anne Berest

this_title: Gabriële Buffet-Picabia, la femme au cerveau érotique
introduction: She was called "the woman with the erotic mind": Gabriele Buffet-Picabia inspired a large number of artists with her intelligence. As the wife of Francis Picabia, friend of Guillaume Apollinaire and lover of Marcel Duchamp, she had a decisive influence on the avant-garde. Based on the incredible life of this unique woman, the documentary shows the frenetic art production in the first half of the 20th century in strongholds such as Paris, Berlin, New York and Barcelona and takes a look at the place of women in art history from an unusual perspective.
